text: This report recommends that the name "Creek Place" be approved to identify an existing public lane located east of Dawes Road, extending southerly from Donora Drive. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Creek Place" for an existing public lane located east of Dawes Road, extending southerly from Donora Drive.
